# Matic Plan And Control
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: write the execution plan and acceptance matrix, update relevant PM Control records, and only then route to Define.

## Purpose

Turn the selected GitHub issue into one executable plan and prepare its relevant PM Control records before implementation.

## Trigger

Run after Matic Select succeeds, or when a selected run is resumed before Define.

Do not run when the issue is not selected, the issue lacks acceptance conditions, or a required human-only decision is unresolved.

## Interface Contract

```text
Selected issue + approved scope + current controls + project context -> define one executable issue plan and pre-build controls -> execution plan, acceptance matrix, and control record
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/01-select/issue-selection.md`, `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-manifest.md`, GitHub issue body and metadata, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-scope-and-requirements.md`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-backlog.md`, `artifacts/lead-lab-web-app-delivery-plan.md`, relevant `pm-control/registers/`, `workspace/workflows/matic/pm-control-contract.md`, and `workspace/workflows/matic/github-lifecycle.md` |
| Transform | Define the implementation boundary, stage path, tests, risks, acceptance matrix, and relevant pre-build PM Control updates |
| Outputs | `execution-plan.md`, `acceptance-matrix.md`, `plan-control-record.md`, updated relevant `pm-control/registers/`, GitHub `acknowledged` label state, and `run-state.md` |

## Input Gate

- Confirm the selected issue title, URL, and label.
- Confirm the issue outcome and acceptance conditions are specific enough to test.
- Map the issue to approved scope or record the human decision required.
- Identify the exact existing Define, Design, Build, Measure, and Learn outputs needed.
- Confirm the clean-branch and reviewer requirements.
- Stop with `Blocked` if authority, scope, acceptance, access, or a required decision is missing.

## Transform

1. Read the selected issue and declared project context.
2. Identify the smallest affected source, test, documentation, deployment, and PM Control carriers.
3. Define the issue boundary, exclusions, implementation sequence, verification commands, manual checks, rollback, and known risks.
4. Map each issue acceptance condition to evidence and the responsible stage.
5. Search current registers and update only relevant records using `pm-control-contract.md`.
6. Add `acknowledged` to the issue after the plan and records pass verification. Keep `matic`.
7. Write the plan, matrix, control record, and run state.

## Outputs

| Output | Location | Format | Intended consumer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Execution plan | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/execution-plan.md` | Markdown | Define and Design |
| Acceptance matrix | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/acceptance-matrix.md` | Markdown table | Measure |
| Plan-control record | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/matic/02-plan-control/plan-control-record.md` | Markdown | Reconcile and audit |
| PM Control records | Relevant files under `pm-control/registers/` | Markdown | Project control source of truth |
| Run state | `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Markdown | Router and resume flow |

## Verify

- The plan names one issue outcome and one implementation boundary.
- Every issue acceptance condition appears in the matrix.
- Every planned PM Control update has a reason and source.
- No human-only decision is presented as made.
- The next stage and exact required inputs are named.
- The issue has `acknowledged` only after the pre-build work is complete.

## Review Gate

Review or Approval when the issue changes approved scope, participant-data handling, external providers, production behavior, or an irreversible operation. Otherwise none.
